description: In every PA-model, a predicate defined by an arithmetic formula with parameters satisfies strong induction in the arithmetic order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.definable_strong_induction.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (P : M → Prop) (hP : Set.univ.Definable₁ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language {x | P x})
  (hs :
    ∀ (x : M),
      (∀ (y : M),
          Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
              (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M y) x →
            P y) →
        P x)
  (x : M) : P x
